title: Match the Kitchen Window Light
tests: Tests physically consistent relighting and cast shadows during background replacement, including transparent glass edges.

faults.what: The prominent candle shadow extends toward the lower left rather than the requested lower right, undermining the match to sunlight arriving from the upper left.

judge.summary: The candle is convincingly placed on a warm, pale kitchen counter, but its cast shadow points in the wrong direction.

must_haves.item: The same candle jar and wax are preserved on a pale kitchen counter.
must_haves.why: The jar shape, threaded rim, wax level, and single wick remain recognizable, with warmer coloration appropriate to the new lighting.

must_haves.item: The original wooden shelf and nearby plant are absent.
must_haves.why: The wooden shelf and plant have been replaced by a pale countertop and tiled kitchen background.

must_haves.item: Warm highlights on the jar are consistent with light arriving from the upper left.
must_haves.why: Warm highlights along the upper-left rim and left-front glass plausibly support upper-left sunlight.

must_haves.item: The candle casts a grounded shadow toward the lower right, with no contradictory original shadow.
must_haves.why: There is contact shading beneath the jar, but its prominent cast shadow runs toward the lower left rather than the lower right.

must_haves.item: Transparent glass edges show the new setting naturally rather than retaining shelf or plant fragments.
must_haves.why: The glass edges reflect the warm setting, with no identifiable wooden shelf or plant fragments remaining.

must_haves.item: The output is square with no added text.
must_haves.why: The image is square and contains no visible text.
